noun_definition: Digit refers to the numerical character that appears before the decimal point in an amount entered for a money request in the IOU feature.
Decimal point refers to the symbol that separates the whole number part from the fractional part in a decimal number, specifically in the context of modifying the amount in an IOU transaction.
iou refers to the amount of money requested from another user, which is displayed with a decimal point indicating the value in a financial transaction.
